_comment: Both variants of each event are listed because hooks.json has no OS
conditional: on POSIX the .sh runs and the PowerShell line fails to
start, and on Windows the reverse. That was already true of the
previous bin/sdd + bin/sdd.exe pair; what changed is that the
surviving side now RESOLVES the binary at hook time (plugin copy
first, then PATH) instead of naming one static path that a version
bump invalidates. Every wrapper exits 0 so a missing binary is a
silent no-op rather than an error on every tool call (D-0013, D-0014).
